degradation_evidence.before: Juniper protocol structs used without memset() initialization, causing use-of-uninitialized-memory
degradation_evidence.after: Multiple structs explicitly zeroed with memset() before use
degradation_evidence.impact: Sanitizer-detected UMR bugs eliminated; harness inputs that previously triggered UMR now execute cleanly

gap_introduced.description: Struct initialization (memset) added to object lifecycle before first use
gap_introduced.harness_needs_update: Yes - harness relying on UMR detection to find bugs in this path will no longer find them

rationale: Adding initialization to the struct lifecycle removes an entire class of memory errors. Fuzzers using memory sanitizers lose a signal source for this code path.

verification.method: Code inspection of print-juniper.c, confirmed by GitHub issue #801
